title: Buttonwood Campground

services.name: Campsites
services.desc: A great camping trip is all about the little things. Buttonwood offers convenient amenities that make your stay easier, more comfortable, and more enjoyable from start to finish. Forgot something or need a quick refill? Our camp store has the essentials, snacks, ice, firewood, and fun Buttonwood items, with delivery right to your site for added convenience. No matter which RV site you choose, you'll enjoy full hook-ups with 30/50-amp electric, water, sewer, cable TV, and WiFi. It's one more way we make your camping experience easy and comfortable. services.name: Cabins
services.desc: Enjoy the comforts of home while staying close to the outdoors with cabin camping at Buttonwood. Our cabins are a great option for guests who want a cozy place to relax while still being steps away from campground activities and amenities. Cabin camping is perfect for families, couples, or anyone looking for an easy, comfortable way to experience Buttonwood. Our rustic cabin is a simple, comfortable place to stay with a double bed and bunk bed, mini splits with Heat and A/C, and outdoor fire ring with picnic table. services.name: Grab Another Tube
services.desc: The Juniata River is as fun as it is beautiful. Calmly winding through Central Pennsylvania and right past Buttonwood Campground, the Juniata offers fantastic recreational activities during your camping stay through its combination of accessible riverbanks, gentle yet steady current, great fishing, and warm waters. Come explore all there is to do! Come on in, the water is fine! Splash in the gentle current, wade in the shallows, or relax on the shore with your toes in the water. Whether from a boat or the bank, fishing the Juniata produces an abundance of Smallmouth Bass, Muskellunge, Walleye, and Catfish.
